games.name: SCI - Pathos III
games.desc:
Special Containment Procedures Foundation
SECURE. CONTAIN. PROTECT.
─────────────────────────────────
Welcome to SCI - Pathos III, one of the most well-known SCP Foundations within the Roblox SCP Genre.
Pathos III is the designation of an installation of facilities created by the SCP Foundation located deep within the Pacific Ocean. The exact depth of the facility remains classified. 

By creating cutting-edge technology and pioneering new containment procedures for the Foundation abroad, this installation contains some of the most dangerous anomalies. It is considered one of the most well-kept strongholds in human history and provides the Foundation with a unique testbed for interactions with anomalous entities and artifacts.
─────────────────────────────────
! 𝐀𝐓𝐓𝐄𝐍𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍 !
The player begins the game as a Class D used in anomalous experiments by the SCP Foundation. In order to join the Foundation, you must apply for Security Class 0.

games.name: Milwaukee Gang Wars 2024
games.desc:
⚠️ READ DESCRIPTION OF GAMEPASSES BEFORE BUYING ANY GAMEPASSES!!
2027 UPDATE!!
Welcome to MGW , a gritty, fast-paced urban roleplay game inspired by street culture, high-risk choices, and real consequences.

Step into a detailed city where crime, law enforcement, and everyday life collide. Choose your role and create your own story — whether you’re a civilian trying to survive, a criminal chasing fast money and faster cars, or a police officer sworn to protect the city.

🔫 Core Features

• Multiple roles: Police, Criminals, and Civilians
• Firearms, tactical gear, and law enforcement tools
• High-speed chases, arrests, investigations, and escapes
• Realistic interactions and decision-based outcomes
• A living city where actions have consequences

🚓 Law vs Crime

Police officers patrol the streets, respond to calls, conduct traffic stops, and pursue suspects. Criminals plan robberies, evade law enforcement, and navigate dangerous situations. Civilians must adapt to the city’s tension.

games.name: Stack Ball
games.desc: Stack Ball is a 3d arcade game where players smash, bump and bounce through revolving helix platforms to reach the end. Sound easy? You wish!! Your ball shatters like a brick through colorful platforms that block its descent, but if you hit a black one, it's all over!

games.name: Noobs vs Zombies Tycoon 2
games.desc:
Noobs vs Zombies Tycoon 2 is a incomplete action-packed game where you fight for World Dominance as a Noob or as a Zombie!

Participate in these large-scaled battles by joining in on Leadership Tycoon where both nations use leaders to deploy everything they've got to eradicate their enemies from the globe: infantry, sieges, planes, helicopters, giants, bosses, and more will be spotted in this war for World Dominance!

If the action in leadership is too much, you can stray away and build up your own personal tycoon in Idle Tycoon, focusing on your own land, defenses, and economy while fending off occasional enemies. (COMING SOON)

Currently running at v0.67.0
Game is immensely incomplete with many key components missing. Everything is subject to change.
